options.text: It already ended centuries ago with no remaining Death-Star craft, no Plain Sight coding, and no flash required, which would leave the.
options.rationale: The operation still runs toward an imminent EMF flash that will strip the facade; it has not already ended centuries ago.

options.label: B
options.text: It only fails for soul families while NPCs keep a private luminous Moon forever outside G.A.A. parameters, which would leave the control.
options.rationale: G.A.A. has seized simulation parameters; the flash disables overlays and Venus light system-wide, not as a private NPC exemption.

options.label: C
options.text: It is finite and nearing absolute termination as G.A.A. control leads to the EMF flash that kills overlays and Venus light.
options.rationale: Structural integrity of the celestial deception is finite and nearing termination under G.A.A. control and the coming EMF flash.

options.label: D
options.text: It is eternal and strengthening, with thicker Venus light after every full moon and no planned holographic shutdown.
options.rationale: The deception is finite and ending; G.A.A. will permanently disable the holographic systems, not thicken them forever.

questions.hint: Finite deception — nearing termination — G.A.A. EMF flash.
